description: NVIDIA GPU Display Driver for Linux contains a vulnerability in the Virtual GPU Manager (vGPU plugin), where a guest VM user may cause an out-of-bounds write by sending a crafted RPC message with invalid performance state list size parameters. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, escalation of privileges, data tampering, denial of service, and information disclosure.
